extensions.name: bugs-music
extensions.description: Bugs Music metadata provider with accurate track and album details, artist catalogs, TOP100, all genre charts from Bugs genre home, Music PD albums, and URL imports. Multi-source ISRC matching across Deezer, Spotify, MusicBrainz, iTunes and YouTube Music with hangul romanization fallback, 183+ artist aliases, iTunes hangul-latin bridging with English-registration feedback re-search, artist-name variant search, album-level lookup, variant-ISRC retry, and duration-verified scoring. Hands confirmed Deezer/Spotify track identifiers (deezer_id/spotify_id) to the app's download resolver so downloads resolve directly instead of falling back to name search.
